subject: MAP: sprint bridge + evidence gating for Nimbus Labs
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: sprint bridge + evidence gating for Nimbus Labs

Tom / Elena —

Following our call today, attaching a lightweight MAP draft (see attached NIMBUS_MAP_v1.xlsx) that aligns evaluation milestones with the legal/procurement items we discussed. High level asks for alignment: 

- Week 1 (Dec 1–5): Security intake + SOC2 evidence review (you already flagged the SOC2 snapshot).
- Week 2 (Dec 8–12): Pilot evaluation (3 internal apps, smoke tests) — Redwood provides staging tokens & on-call.
- Week 3 (Dec 15–19): Order form finalization and procurement signoff; target signature week is Dec 22 if gating items cleared.

Dependencies called out in the MAP: MSA finalization -> DPA addendum (if needed) -> Order form signature. In practice our legal team prefers MSA + Order form signed concurrently, with DPA executed as an exhibit where possible to speed procurement.

Can you confirm:
1) Who on your side will own SOC2 artifact delivery (PDF or upload link) and when can we expect it?
2) Any internal procurement blackout dates in Dec we should avoid?

I'll loop in Laura (legal) and Karthik (contracts) to call out sequencing risk and any redline expectations. If you prefer, we can stage the deal: canary pilot on hosted capacity first and order form following conditional on pilot acceptance.

Thanks — quick next steps would be: you confirm artifact owner + proposed date for signature window and we lock the MAP.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: NIMBUS_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2_snapshot_20251120.pdf (evidence)

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear cadence. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC2 artifacts: Security (that's me) will upload the SOC2 snapshot + control matrix to the shared folder by EOD Tue (Dec 2). I'll also include a short readme with what is redacted (we redact customer names).
- Procurement calendar: Procurement head is out Dec 10–14 (we have a blackout for signature that week).

Given that blackout, can we push Order form target to week of Dec 15 (signature target Dec 17–19)? If we agree, we can run the pilot in Week 2 (Dec 8–12) but need to accept that procurement won't be able to sign during the blackout.

One ask from security: we prefer the DPA language to be an exhibit to the MSA (so internal legal doesn't have to pull a separate procurement ticket). Happy to review the MSA redlines when you have them.

Tom
Director, Security & Privacy | Nimbus Labs
tom.harris@nimbus-labs.com | +1 617-555-0222

Thanks — looping in our legal sequencing notes so everyone is aligned: 

- Preferred sequencing: MSA (clean execution) + Order Form executed together. If Nimbus insists on an order-form-first approach, we will accept a countersigned order form with an MSA in 48–72 hour notice to sign.
- DPA: acceptable as an exhibit (Tom's note is fine) — we will prepare a DPA exhibit that references the MSA and order form so procurement sees a single package.
- Redlines: Karthik will drive the contract redline set (we expect a few commercial concessions only). Karthik — can you please push the MSA redlines to the Drive link and flag any clauses that will likely need an escalation (e.g., indemnity caps, data residency)?

Risks to call out now: procurement blackout (Dec 10–14) and any SOC2 gaps that require SOC2 Type II evidence (that could add a week). If SOC2 artifacts are partial we can accept gap remediation with a binding acceptance window in the MAP (pilot accepted -> final execution within 7 business days).

I'll add legal owners to the MAP and stitch the order form draft into the folder. Attached: draft_orderform_20251128.docx (placeholder).

Laura Bennett
Director, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

- Week of Dec 8: Pilot execution window (Redwood engineering on-call).
- Week of Dec 15: Procurement review + target signature window Dec 17–19 (adjusted from original).

Action items I will take on today:

- Create a conditional acceptance clause in the MAP that says: "Pilot acceptance must occur prior to Order Form signature; if SOC2 Type II evidence is incomplete, Nimbus may sign with a remediation schedule to be completed within 10 business days."

Tom — can you confirm by EOD Tue that the SOC2 upload is complete (or share the Drive link)? If we get that, Karthik will move the MSA redlines to the shared folder and we can target legal review on Wed/Thu.

Thanks all — I'll update the MAP and post a short meeting invite (15 min) to lock owners and dates.

Quick legal check-in — I uploaded our MSA redlines (MSA_redlines_karthik_1129.docx) to the Drive folder and called out three sections that often require commercial escalation: 

1) Indemnity / Limitation of Liability: propose $5M cap; we can be flexible with higher caps tied to ARR thresholds.
2) Data residency clause: we will accept US hosting with contractual assurances; any EU-only residency requests will require a different order form.
3) Audit / SOC2: if Nimbus's SOC2 is Type II and covers the services, that should be sufficient; if partial, we will accept a remediation schedule as Rachel proposed.

Tom — please acknowledge once you review the redlines so we can triage any sticking points before legal review Wed/Thu. If any escalation is needed, flag who at Nimbus should join (VP Legal or GC).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
